title: Oxva Nexlim 2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The OXVA Nexlim 2 Kit is a premium pod system built to deliver outstanding flavour and highly customisable performance within a compact, durable zinc alloy chassis. Driven by a substantial 2000mAh integrated battery, this device provides a reliable power output of up to 40W, comfortably lasting most vapers a full day of continuous use. When a recharge is required, the ultra-fast 3A USB-C connection safely replenishes the battery to 80 percent in approximately 20 minutes, keeping downtime to an absolute minimum. Operating the Nexlim 2 is both intuitive and versatile thanks to its vibrant 0.85-inch colour screen with ten interchangeable visual themes. The intelligent chipset automatically recommends the optimal power setting via Smart Mode, while allowing users to manually switch between a battery-saving ECO Mode and a high-performance Power Mode. Combined with a responsive inhale activation system and a precision three-level airflow slider, tailoring your ideal draw is effortless. The kit is equipped with the latest 2ml UNITECH 3.0 Nexlim pods, which feature a convenient top-fill design and advanced leak-resistant technology. Inside, the built-in dual mesh coils utilise a Super Pulse System to ensure rapid heating and rich, consistent flavour delivery. Supplied with both 0.6ohm and 0.8ohm pods, this setup is perfectly optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) styles, performing exceptionally well with 50/50 e-liquids and Nicotine Salts. Battery life is dependent on usage and wattage settings. We recommend paring this kit with the following e-liquids: OXVA NEXLIM V2 Side Fill 0.6ohm RDTL - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids OXVA NEXLIM V2 Side Fill 0.8ohm MTL - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids OXVA NEXLIM V2 Side Fill 1.2ohm MTL - Use 50/50 Freebase Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
